dogecoin.text: The funniest thing Elon could do on SNL tonight is to shit on the Dogecoin rally and tank the price. If he were really in it for the laughs, that'd be truly hilarious.
The “increased availability of Dogecoin on other cryptocurrency trading platforms” could be a problem for Robinhood, it said today in its S-1 filing. Coinbase just listed DOGE earlier this month
